table.name: TLGNC_LOAD
table.description: Data about an individual load on a vehicle (truck, trailer, wagon) or container. A load can be created independent of an order or assignment, and the load is not automatically deleted when cancelling an assigment or order: somebody has to decide what to do with the load, i.e. the material which physically exists on that vehicle/container. Either unload the unit, or assign it to another order/assignment where the material can be used. A load is very closely related to the weighing system, it stores also all kind of weighing-data (besides the pure tare/net amount) in case the weighing system can provide them. For bag and bulk materials, for services no load is created.

column.name: LOAD_NUMBER
column.description: Column used for sending unique identification number of load to external systems

column.name: LOADED_FROM_LOAD_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_load. References the load record from which this load is to be substracted. Set whenever the load comes from a source which is represented as a load record in logon, e.g. bimodal orders. Null if load was loaded from a normal shipping point.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. Material which is loaded.

column.name: PRODUCTION_PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. Plant which produced the material for this load.

column.name: TARE_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Weight of the empty truck+trailer+container or wagon + container(s) for this load in tons. Application enforces when this value is mandatory depending on status of the loading/material packaging type. Previously called TARE_QUANTITY, but now putting stress on the fact that it is a weight and it is always stored in tons.

column.name: GROSS_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Gross weight of the loaded truck+trailer+container or wagon + container(s) in tons. Application enforces when this value is mandatory depending on status of the loading/material packaging type.

column.name: NET_QUANTITY
column.description: Application enforces when this value is mandatory depending on status of the loading/material packaging type. tare + net = gross does only apply if the net is convertible into tons. A proper solution would also comprise the explicit field GROSS_WEIGHT_T, which would allow to reliably display the gross weight in all situations (cubic metres not convertible into tons, for instance).

column.name: NET_QUANTITY_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of measure for net_quantity.

column.name: ACCURATE_QUANTITIES_FLAG
column.description: Set to 1=true, if the numbers in tare_quantity/net_quantity are the result of an exact measure: weighed or counted quantities. When unloading from a wagon into a truck (bimodal, 'Freiverlad'), the resulting load of the truck is typically not exact (unless there is a weighing system that can be used there). If a truck unloads not exactly, all trucks of that wagon must go to the same shipto.

column.name: LOAD_ORDER_ID
column.description: Unique id for parallel rail. Built from separate sequence, as the load can be sent several times during its lifetime. NULL if the load is not currently known/confirmed in the external system (not transmitted or cancelled). This field was named PARALLEL_VERLADEAUFTRAG_ID before.

column.name: LOAD_ORDER_ITEM_ID
column.description: Unique id for the weighing system. Built from separate sequence, as the load can be sent several times during its lifetime. NULL if the load is not currently known/confirmed in the external system (not transmitted or cancelled). This field has been introduced with the generic LDS interface.

column.name: ACTUAL_CHROMAT_REDUCTION_MONTH
column.description: Actual value for the 'chromat reduction in months' at the time the material is loaded, typically received from parallel. Value must only be set if really KNOWN at type of loading, otherwise leave value as null. TODO 20090929, for later release: Additional rules will be needed what value should be printed on the delivery note, or what should be done if value contradicts tlgnc_mat_plant.chromat_reduction_months and/or tlgns_sap_bp_sarea.chromat_reduction_months.

column.name: LOADINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_loadingpoint. The actual loadingpoint where the load was loaded.

column.name: TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_truck. Truck on which the load is loaded. At least one of truck, trailer, container, simple vehicle or wagon needs to be set. Several IDs can be set according to the current composition of the vehicle(s)/container.

column.name: TRAILER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_trailer. Trailer on which the load is loaded. At least one of truck, trailer, container, simple vehicle or wagon needs to be set. Several IDs can be set according to the current composition of the vehicle(s)/container.

column.name: CONTAINER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_container. Container on which the load is loaded. At least one of truck, trailer, container, simple vehicle or wagon needs to be set. Several IDs can be set according to the current composition of the vehicle(s)/container.

column.name: WAGON_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_wagon. Wagon on which the load is loaded. At least one of truck, trailer, container, simple vehicle or wagon needs to be set. Several IDs can be set according to the current composition of the vehicle(s)/container.

column.name: SIMPLE_VEHICLE_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_simple_vehicle. Simple vehicle on which the load is loaded. At least one of truck, trailer, container, simple vehicle or wagon needs to be set. Several IDs can be set according to the current composition of the vehicle(s)/container.

column.name: CHAMBER_NUMBER
column.description: number of the chamber on the load's containing entity (truck, trailer, container, wagon).

column.name: LOADING_TS
column.description: Date and Time when START loading occurred.

column.name: UNLOADING_TS
column.description: Date and time when unloading occurred. Setting the timestamps means that the load's container is empty -> ready to return and be loaded again.

column.name: WS_TARE_QUIT_WARN_FLAG
column.description: Set to 1=true, Set if the truck driver has received a tare warning, accepted it and started loading anyway. A tare warning occurs if the delta between measured tare weight and tare weight from master data is over a certain limit.. Currently only stored in Logon, no logic attached to it.

column.name: WS_SILO_NO
column.description: Silo number from where load was loaded, as received from weighing system. No logic in Logon, only for information.

column.name: WS_SILO_NAME
column.description: Silo name from where load was loaded, as received from weighing system. No logic in Logon, only for information.

column.name: WS_SAMPLE_NO
column.description: Sample number (in case a sample was taken for quality assurance), as received from weighing system. No logic in Logon, only for information.

column.name: WS_DELIVERY_NOTE_NO
column.description: Filled with the LDS delivery note number when deallocating a loaded non-tour order from a truck or when pre-loading a rail order as a means to propagate it to the new order (re-routing).

column.name: WS_ORDER_TEMPLATE_NO
column.description: Order number given by the weighing system. (Currently sent by WeWaS in endLoad)

column.name: WS_EICHBELEG1
column.description: Calibration record number of first weighing, comma separated. (Currently sent by WeWaS/Parallel in endLoad)

column.name: WS_EICHBELEG1_TIME
column.description: Date/time of first weighing. (Currently sent by WeWaS/Parallel in endLoad)

column.name: WS_EICHBELEG1_BALANCE
column.description: ID of the balance, comma separated. (Currently sent by Parallel in endLoad)

column.name: WS_EICHBELEG2
column.description: Calibration record number of second weighing, comma separated. (Currently sent by WeWaS/Parallel in endLoad)

column.name: WS_EICHBELEG2_TIME
column.description: Date/time of second weighing. (Currently sent by WeWaS/Parallel in endLoad)

column.name: WS_EICHBELEG2_BALANCE
column.description: ID of the balance, comma separated. (Currently sent by Parallel in endLoad)

column.name: WS_CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO
column.description: Customer/external order number. (Currently sent by WeWaS in endLoad)

column.name: WS_ENTER_SHIPPINGPOINT_TIME
column.description: Date/time truck entered the shippingpoint as reported by the weighing system. (Currently sent by WeWaS in endLoad)

column.name: WS_LEAVE_SHIPPINGPOINT_TIME
column.description: Date/time truck left the shippingpoint as reported by the weighing system. (Currently sent by WeWaS in endLoad)

column.name: WS_START_LOADINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_loadingpoint. Loadingpoint information received as part of the START-load. This loadingpoint info has no logic in Logon, it is only used to document the loading/weighing process, e.g. for the delivery note. This loadingpoint info should correspond to the balance used for 'Eichbeleg 1'. In the future, a weighing system could send a corrected/confirmed START-loadingpoint as part of the END Load as well, together with the Eichbeleg data. (Both Parallel and WeWaS do currently not support this though).

column.name: WS_END_LOADINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_loadingpoint. Loadingpoint information received as part of the END-load. This loadingpoint info has no logic in Logon, it is only used to document the loading/weighing process, e.g. for the delivery note. This loadingpoint info should correspond to the balance used for 'Eichbeleg 2', and is always the LP received as part of the endLoad. This value will be identical to order_item.loadingpoint_id but can be set independent of an order (e.g., set also in preloading). Start- and End Loadingpoint may differ, e.g. when loading was interrupted because of an empty silo etc.

column.name: WS_ORIGINAL_TARE_MEASURE_T
column.description: Original number received from the weighing system as tare measure (first weighing/before loading). This value is kept for legal purposes and may be used in delivery notes. It is forbidden to change this value by any other means in the application! A value received from e.g. PDA must NOT be stored here, only when received from a weighing system directly.

column.name: WS_ORIGINAL_GROSS_MEASURE_T
column.description: Original number received from the weighing system as gross measure (last weighing/after loading). This value is kept for legal purposes and may be used in delivery notes. It is forbidden to change this value by any other means in the application! A value received from e.g. PDA must NOT be stored here, only when received from a weighing system directly.

column.name: WS_TRUCK_PLATE_NO
column.description: Truck plate number as sent by the weighing system. Only set if the truck is artificial / not known in Logon (for example EXW case Fenics).

column.name: WS_TRAILER_PLATE_NO
column.description: Trailer plate number as sent by the weighing system. Only set if the truck is artificial / not known in Logon (for example EXW case Fenics).

column.name: WS_CARRIER
column.description: Carrier as sent by the weighing system. Only set if the truck is artificial / not known in Logon (for example EXW case Fenics).

column.name: MIX_DESIGN_ID
column.description: FK to tlgnc_fireq_material_mixdesign. Mix design id of this restriction. Mix design can only be specified for aggregate material + production plant combination. Mix design business term: Recipe/Formula of the material composition of the aggregates material.

column.name: LDS_OFFLINE_MODE
column.description: Indicates if load should have been loaded by the LDS, but it was loaded by the PDA instead and the load requires regularization.
